title: Exploration of lignin-binding synthetic polymers with pendant hydrophobic amino acids
content:
RSC Sustain., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00433G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tomonari Tanaka, Rika Hinohara, Oscar Abraham Carias Duron, Yuji Aso, Naoko Kobayashi, Kaori Saito, Takashi Watanabe
Polymers bearing hydrophobic amino acid moieties were synthesized, and their binding affinities with wood lignin were investigated. The polymers bearing tryptophan and phenylalanine moieties were observed to exhibit high binding affinity.
